title: Will the FDA approve a psilocybin treatment during 2026?
resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as **Yes** if the US Food and Drug Administration approves a psilocybin treatment during 2026.
fine_print:
This question only refers to market authorisation for medical treatment in humans, including emergency use authorisations.

For purposes of this question, a "psilocybin treatment" is defined as any drug with psilocybin as its active ingredient.
background:
[Psilocybin](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Psilocybin) is a hallucinogenic drug that is naturally produced in over 200 species of [mushroom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Psilocybin_mushroom). [Illegal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Legal_status_of_psilocybin_mushrooms) in most of the world, the drug has been studied as a possible treatment for various psychiatric disorders, including depression, OCD, and PTSD.

Although approved for medical use in countries such as [Australia and Czechia](https://balkaninsight.com/2025/07/02/psychedelic-healing-czechia-opens-mind-to-magic-mushroom-therapy/) and even fully legal in countries such as [Jamaica](https://www.vice.com/en/article/jamaica-magic-mushrooms-legal-loophole/), the United States FDA has so far [declined to approve](https://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-news/fda-rejects-psychedelic-mdma-assisted-therapy-ptsd-rcna165531) psilocybin treatment.

Psilocybin is illegal on the [federal level](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Psilocybin_decriminalization_in_the_United_States) and classified as a Schedule 1 substance, but has been decriminalized and legalized for medical use in various states, while the FDA may approve treatments regardless of its Schedule 1 status.

comments.author: josheee
comments.text: At 10%, below the community, on regulatory-timeline grounds. The lead program is COMPASS Pathways' COMP360 psilocybin for treatment-resistant depression: its first pivotal Phase 3 (COMP005) read out positive on the primary endpoint, but a US approval typically needs the second pivotal (COMP006, reading out around 2026) before an NDA, and FDA review of a novel drug then runs roughly ten to twelve months and would almost certainly go to an advisory committee. Stacking a second-pivotal readout, NDA submission, adcomm, and a PDUFA decision all inside calendar 2026 is a very tight sequence. The base rate is further weighed down by the FDA's August 2024 rejection of Lykos's MDMA for PTSD, where it demanded another Phase 3 over functional-unblinding and durability concerns that apply equally to psilocybin. A 2027 approval looks far more likely than 2026, so I sit around 10%. I would move up on an accepted NDA filing with priority review and a 2026 PDUFA date.

comments.author: JesusDeSivar
comments.text:
Reasoning:

* FDA granted psilocybin "breakthrough therapy" designation (2018, 2019)
* Compass Pathways expects decision in "late 2026 or early 2027"
* Phase 3 trials ongoing with 800+ patients
* Rolling submission planned after "positive" FDA meeting
* Approved in Australia and Czechia already

Key factors for 2026 approval:

* Breakthrough designation enables expedited review
* Strong clinical trial data accumulating
* Over 1,000 patients studied across all phases
* FDA issued guidance on psychedelic drug trials (shows engagement)
* Treatment-resistant depression has significant unmet need

Key factors against 2026 approval:

* Compass Pathways targeting "late 2026 or early 2027" = may slip to 2027
* Schedule I status creates additional hurdles
* Novel mechanism requires careful safety review
* Training requirements for administration
* Political sensitivity around psychedelics

Timeline considerations:

* "Late 2026" suggests Oct-Dec decision at earliest
* FDA reviews typically take 10 months after submission
* Rolling submission could accelerate but still tight for 2026

Confidence: Medium

comments.author: bromo
comments.text:
> My prediction is based on the significant gap between clinical trial completion and the FDA's administrative review window for 2026.- ​**The Timeline Constraint:** Compass Pathways (COMP360) is currently the lead candidate. As of January 2026, their pivotal Phase 3 (COMP006) data is not expected until early Q3 2026.
> - ​**The FDA Review Cycle:** Even if the New Drug Application (NDA) is filed immediately in late Q3, the FDA typically requires a 60-day filing acceptance window followed by a 6-month Priority Review for Breakthrough Therapies. This mathematically pushes the PDUFA date into early 2027.
> - ​**Regulatory Scrutiny:** Following the rejection of Lykos' MDMA application in 2024/2025, the FDA has signaled a more conservative approach toward psychedelic data interpretation, making an "Accelerated Approval" before the 2026 deadline unlikely.​I am significantly below the community median (50%) because the market is likely overestimating the speed of the regulatory process despite the high probability of clinical success.
